corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply correctly emphasizes that coherentist evaluation concerns an interconnected explanatory web and raises a legitimate comparative question about why one worldview may stop with primitive logic while rejecting primitive theological commitments. Principal limitation: Calling the opponent's stopping point arbitrary does not demonstrate arbitrariness, because explanatory regress must terminate somewhere and primitive logical necessity may possess comparative advantages unavailable to an equally primitive divine posit. Live burden: The affirmative must provide nonquestion-begging criteria for acceptable termini, apply them symmetrically to logic and God, and answer the fallibilist standard rather than equating every unexplained primitive with unrestricted ad hoc assertion. Locked score: The mixed band reflects meaningful contact with a central primitive-logic defense and a relevant coherentist perspective, reduced by partial responsiveness, undefined standards of nonarbitrariness, weakened treatment of the strongest alternative, and an overstated claim that arbitrariness would end rational debate.

corrections.originalCritique: Strongest feature: The reply isolates two indispensable bridges in a necessity argument: showing that the phenomenon requires further explanation and showing that relevant competing explanations fail, rather than inferring theism from an unfilled explanatory space. Principal limitation: Read literally, demanding elimination of every logically possible alternative would be excessive, although the locked formulation appropriately confines the requirement to relevant live alternatives within the claimed transcendental reductio. Live burden: The affirmative must either satisfy those comparative requirements or demonstrate that denial of the proposed Orthodox ground itself produces contradiction, while the negative must recognize that class-level exclusion need not enumerate limitless imaginative possibilities. Locked score: The very strong band reflects exceptional precision, responsiveness, calibration, and motion-level relevance, with only a narrow qualification concerning how comprehensively alternatives must be surveyed and whether a properly formulated transcendental strategy could exclude them collectively.
